items.message: First week: check-up, health booklet and microchip. Ask about the vaccination schedule, year-round deworming and leishmaniasis prevention (common in the area).
No contact with unknown dogs until the vaccination schedule set by the vet is complete.
Raised bed, dry straw and no draughts, in the barn or the kennel.
Keep her away from pine trees and caterpillar lines. Contact means a veterinary emergency.
Check ears, paws and nose after every walk.
Shade and fresh water at all times. Parasite protection: ask the vet.
Poisons, fertilisers, diesel and workshop products out of reach.
Do not let her off the leash near them until she masters come and leave it.

note: Warnings only. No doses, products or treatments: health always ends in the fixed phrases health.consultVet or health.vetEmergency.
